scenario: Aug 10: Iran's Supreme National Security Council set new conditions for reopening Hormuz on Aug 8 - lifting the US naval blockade and sanctions, troop withdrawal, war reparations and frozen-asset release - while an ADNOC vessel was struck by missile transiting the Strait the same day, the third attack on its fleet this week (Al Jazeera, Aug 8). Kpler recorded only 8 Hormuz crossings on Aug 7, down 33% day-on-day, mostly via Iran's Unilateral Scheme (Middle East Eye, Aug 8). Brent $84.35, WTI $78.74 and TTF 56.34 EUR/MWh; the JKM CFD reference eased to $21.12 (Trading Economics, Aug 7) while the $22.00 September-delivery assessment remains carried. Qatar LNG force majeure remains carried through mid-September. Crisis level remains 4 (High); base 12%, stress 55%, tail 33%.

categories.label: Food & Agriculture
categories.supplyChainImpact: Middle East fertilizer and energy exports remain constrained while Hormuz traffic holds at just 8 confirmed crossings on Aug 7, down 33% day-on-day and far below the ~88/day pre-war norm (Kpler via Middle East Eye, Aug 8).
